claims.sentence: A retrospective study on the therapeutic efficacy of limbal autografts indicated that these procedures were clinically successful in about 60-70% of treated patients, and their success was tightly related to the presence of at least 3.0% of holoclone-forming (∆Np63α-bright) keratinocytes in the primary cultures from which the epithelial sheets were generated [ 9 ].
